evidence.title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning

summary: Researchers have built a machine‑learning system that can flag potentially fraudulent memecoins on the Solana blockchain before they execute rug‑pull schemes. The model analyzes token metadata, transaction patterns, and developer behavior to give investors and exchanges early warning of scams.
title: Machine Learning Model Predicts Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana Ahead of Rug Pulls
